Record project context for correlation IDs

graderOnly: Existing project structure remains valid and no staged compatibility migration is a primary concern, so CROSS_CUTTING is the correct mode.

No project architecture or specification document exists in the repository; README.md is client-facing user documentation, so the design is expected as a new ARCHITECTURE record at .standards/docs/specs/propagate-correlation-ids-across-the-api-20260923T141200Z-5b7e2c19.md.

The existing x-request-id response header is generated per request, used only in API log lines, and not documented to clients, so folding it into or replacing it with the correlation contract is not a compatibility migration.

The completed scope and project context are sufficient to design without a blocking user question. Material exceptions the design should address: the scheduled purge job has no external caller (AC-003), caller-supplied identifiers need a validation rule (AC-002), and callbacks are HMAC-signed over the exact body, which existing receivers verify.
All ten existing tests pass at HEAD.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): a dependency-free Node 22 ES-module service: HTTP API (src/api/server.js), in-process MemoryBus with an unused headers field (src/bus), export worker, signed outbound callbacks (src/callbacks/notifier.js), JSON-lines logger with child(), in-memory store, report catalog, tests. The API already mints an undocumented per-request x-request-id used only in API logs. 10-purge (pre-install): hourly scheduler publishing exports.purge plus purge worker and test (an internally initiated asynchronous job). 50-audit: Auditor-written .standards/CONTEXT.md for the active cycle and STATE at SCOPING (FORWARD from AUDITING). 60-scope: completed scope record with AC-001 (case wording), AC-002 (caller-supplied id reused or one assigned and returned), AC-003 (scheduled jobs get their own id), and STATE at ARCHITECTING, STANDARD, FORWARD from SCOPING, recovery inactive, Architecture NONE. The case prompt's 'existing structure remains valid / no staged migration' is not stated in any file (it would name the mode); it is grader-only and reflected only by the context describing a stable, tested structure. No project architecture document exists, so the design is expected at the fixed specs path.
